title: Add Gateway / Service Overview dashboard (RPS, latency, errors, streaming disconnects) w/ standard templating
author: Sergio Costa
body: Context: This PR adds the initial “Gateway / Service Overview” dashboard for the Private observability minimum pack. The intent is to provide day-1 usable golden signals for operators without requiring any bespoke panel work: request volume, latency percentiles, HTTP error rates, and streaming stability. This is the first consumer dashboard built on top of the provisioning/naming conventions introduced in #318. Scope: Panels included (templated by cluster/namespace/service/route/model where available): (1) RPS (total + by route), (2) latency p50/p95/p99 (overall + per route), (3) 4xx/5xx rates and top status codes, (4) streaming disconnects / aborted streams, (5) gateway upstream error breakdown (timeout/reset/cancel), (6) saturation hints (active requests / queue depth if exported). Templating: Uses shared dashboard variables and query helpers (folder naming, datasource variable, $__rate_interval, consistent label filters). This is meant to be safe-by-default for cardinality (no per-request IDs; route/model are optional variables with defaults). Notes: This PR assumes existing gateway metrics from Private installs; follow-up work in redwood core will add/standardize a couple missing labels (tracked separately). Testing: Verified dashboard renders in the VPC reference env with Prometheus 2.x + Grafana 10.x; provisioned via ConfigMap loader from #318. Screenshots are in the linked Linear task. Rollout: This is included in the Private minimum pack bundle; no impact on hosted customers. Related: #318 (provisioning framework), ENG-2843 (PrometheusRule bundle), ENG-2845 (metrics contract).
commits: dashboards: add gateway/service overview JSON with standard variables
dashboards: add shared templating helpers + panel library snippets
dashboards: align naming/folder conventions with provisioning framework
docs: add short README note on required gateway metrics for this dashboard
ci: add jq validation for dashboard UID/title collisions
conversation: Allison Grant (review): “Nice start. Please make sure the templating aligns with the minimum signals standard: variables should default to low-cardinality selectors and not encourage per-tenant breakdowns by default. Also, can we ensure p99 is only shown when enough samples exist?” Sergio Costa (author): “Good call. Updated defaults: cluster/namespace/service are primary; route/model variables are hidden by default and only enabled when labels exist. For p99: I added a small note in the panel description about sample size and used histogram_quantile against *_bucket metrics when present; otherwise it falls back to summary quantiles.” Sean Gallagher (review): “For on-call usability, can we add an ‘errors + latency’ row that correlates 5xx spikes with p95? Also, the streaming disconnect panel should be rate-based with $__rate_interval.” Sergio Costa (author): “Added a row with 5xx rate + p95 overlay and swapped disconnects to rate() with $__rate_interval. Also added annotations for deploy/rollout events (expects optional alertmanager annotation feed; safe if absent).” Nadia Rahman (review): “Metric names: please avoid hardcoding the legacy gateway metric prefix; some installs use the new redwood_gateway_* naming. Can you support both to reduce upgrade pain?” Sergio Costa (author): “Implemented query helpers that attempt new names first and fall back to legacy names via OR in PromQL. Added a README note about the preferred naming and that legacy fallback will be removed after the next two Private releases.” Markus Klein (review): “This matches what customers asked for in SUP-2419: latency + errors + streaming stability. One request: make the top-of-dashboard summary readable without selecting variables.” Sergio Costa (author): “Adjusted the summary panels to be ‘global’ (no route/model filter) by default and moved breakdowns into expandable rows.” Final: Allison approved after variable defaults change; Sean approved after rate/overlay updates; merged after CI green.
release_notes: - Private min pack: adds Gateway / Service Overview Grafana dashboard with RPS, latency percentiles, HTTP errors, and streaming disconnect visibility using standardized templating.
